name: Motif layout transfer
role: Turns the arrangement of existing motifs into adjustable constraints; template transfer has prior research

name: SBGN Bricks
role: Building blocks and specification for drawing biological processes; used to organize semantics and templates

name: SetCoLa
role: Groups by attribute and expresses high-level constraints

name: Metabopolis
role: Partitioning of metabolic maps into blocks, layout within blocks and connections between blocks

name: SAMMI
role: Compartment partitioning of metabolic maps, main/side nodes, graphical copies and Escher exchange
status: Workflow reference; performance not independently reproduced

name: HOLA
role: Decomposition into a core and tree-like branches; useful for its skeleton-first idea
status: The old Python 2 implementation is not used as a dependency; the current C++ libdialect belongs to Adaptagrams and was not compiled for comparison

name: ELK Layered
role: Layout of blocks with ported modules and orthogonal macro-level connections
status: elkjs 0.12.1 actually run; the internal reaction graph still uses straight-line connections

name: fCoSE
role: Force-directed completion of compound graphs with fixed anchors

name: SBMLNetwork
role: Alternative baseline for SBML layout and fixed-position elements
status: Interface checked; not installed, performance not reproduced

name: Adaptagrams / libavoid
role: Obstacle avoidance and orthogonal routing; handles paths inside modules and at their boundaries
status: Listed as the next routing integration; not yet compiled or evaluated, so effectiveness cannot be claimed

name: DeepDrawing
role: Example-driven graph layout; not a pretrained model on expert metabolic maps

name: SmartGD
role: Learning method that includes non-differentiable aesthetic objectives
status: Literature reference; not reproduced on this project's data

name: LayoutDM (Inoue et al., CVPR 2023)
role: Design of conditional layout, masking and completion tasks; the original task is page-element layout
status: Borrows the task format; does not use weights pretrained on its page data

name: MetaCarto
status: A historically unimplemented learning scheme is not experimental counter-evidence

name: Reactome diagram specifications
role: Specification of the correspondence between layout, entities, events and graph structure
status: Two diagrams actually downloaded and cross-checked for connections, identities and explicit stoichiometry

name: WikiPathways monthly GPML archive
role: Pinned to 20261010; multi-species geometry and annotation source
status: 41 species packages actually downloaded; a single line is not inferred to be a complete reaction

name: MetaNetX MNXref
role: For later identity bridging; mind direction, compartment and proton handling
status: Documentation checked; this version did not import the full MNXref and bridges through explicit ChEBI annotations of the local models

name: Rhea
role: Standardization of expert reaction identity and direction
status: Optional mapping source for later; the full data was not imported
